profile.name: Yomi Fabiyi
profile.headline: Software that works beyond the demo.
profile.intro: I'm Yomi, a full-stack developer focused on Python, Django, APIs, and practical web applications. I build products with attention to the details behind the screen.
profile.response_time: Direct inquiries responded to within 24–48 hours.
profile.core_stack: Python · Django · FastAPI · Postgres · React · JavaScript · Go
profile.philosophy: From simple schemas to the global space.
bio: I believe great software is defined by how well it performs under real-world conditions, not just how it looks in a screenshot. My focus is on writing maintainable backend services, architecting relational databases that scale cleanly, and crafting responsive web interfaces that don't get in the user's way.

Whether it's designing REST endpoints with Django REST Framework, optimizing SQL queries, or integrating asynchronous workflows, I enjoy taking projects from blank repository to reliable, deployed production environments.

Over the years, I've developed a rigorous workflow centered around clear database schemas, comprehensive API design, and deterministic automated testing. I view frontend implementation not as an afterthought, but as the natural manifestation of a well-architected backend contract.
profile.quote: Software architecture is not about anticipating every unknown future requirement. It is about making decisions today that leave tomorrow's choices open.
